assumptions: The adjustment input is the signed sum of precisely the issuer’s operating-profit reconciling items, not all adjustments shown elsewhere in the income statement.
Reported profit and adjustments use the same issuer, period and currency and do not double-count expenses.
limitations: This is an issuer-defined non-IFRS measure; other companies and periods may define and label adjustments differently.
An add-back need not represent a nonrecurring cost, cash flow or an adjustment appropriate for an independent valuation.
